topic: How does the 14.6% bandwidth affect frequency planning for multi-satellite networks with adjacent channel interference risks?
response: 14.6% bandwidth affects frequency planning by limiting adjacent channel interference risks. ITU standards recommend 10-20% guard bands for satellite networks. A 14.6% bandwidth allocation allows for efficient frequency reuse while mitigating interference.
reference_context: Downlink coverage analysis shows frequency reuse improves coverage probability, while bandwidth allocation affects data rate due to interference and path loss exponent.
